title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M | TechCrunch
summary: Okta on Thursday agreed to acquire AI identity security startup Permiso Security , betting that demand for protecting AI agents and other machine identities will grow as enterprises deploy autonomous software across their operations.
